integrity: The proof is uniform in the field size and dimension. The standard-library verifier tests finite fields, explicit modal formulas, exhaustive small valuations and modal partition refinement; finite experiments do not certify the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: All one-dimensional affine directions are individually named. The depth-three bound is an upper bound, and the count of noncollinear triples does not exhaust all possible generating triples for larger fields. Dimension one and non-Desarguesian affine planes are not covered.
title: Three markers suffice for every finite affine-direction S5 frame
